tagline: Up Lookout Mountain, with a yard sale every August.
intro: The parkway starts in Gadsden and follows Lookout Mountain north toward Chattanooga, 93 miles across three states. In Alabama it passes farms and woodland, the deep gorge of Little River Canyon, DeSoto State Park and Mentone, a town on the crest at about 1,700 feet.

For four days from the first Thursday in August the road joins the World's Longest Yard Sale, which began on US 127 between Kentucky and Chattanooga. A few years in, the parkway was added, and the sale now runs south along the mountain as far as Gadsden.

moments.title: Noccalula Falls
moments.text: A 90-foot waterfall in Gadsden, with trails down Black Creek Gorge past caves, an old dam and Civil War carvings, and a covered bridge from 1899 in the park.

moments.title: DeSoto State Park
moments.text: Developed by the Civilian Conservation Corps in the 1930s beside the Little River, the park keeps DeSoto Falls, 104 feet and the state's highest, in a separate section to the north.

moments.title: Mentone
moments.text: Named for Menton in France and home to an unusual number of summer camps, it was nearest the epicenter of a 2003 magnitude 4.6 earthquake that alarmed residents before dawn and injured no one.
